subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw core own this Agentic-OS-specific lease and session-orchestration protocol, or should the integration move behind a plugin/owner-specific seam with only generic core hooks?
rationale: The PR adds a broad, durable public Gateway and storage contract rather than repairing an established behavior, so code review cannot determine the intended long-term owner boundary.

options.title: Require a plugin-oriented boundary
options.body: Pause this PR and move the Agentic-OS-specific protocol to its owner integration, proposing only narrow generic core hooks if a real extension gap remains.

options.title: Adopt as a supported core Gateway API
options.body: Keep the work in core, but explicitly sponsor the API, define versioning and restart/upgrade semantics, and require focused live interoperability proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Require a plugin-oriented boundary
recommendation.body: Pause this PR and move the Agentic-OS-specific protocol to its owner integration, proposing only narrow generic core hooks if a real extension gap remains.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete Gateway or agent-runtime owner could not be proven without the blocked git-history inspection.
